title: THE WHAT IS NEW CARD NAMES THE CONTROLLER MENUS
why: The card was stamped v19.62 and the stamp may not trail the build by more than 0.15. Its new second line names the player 2 controller menus (v19.68 to v19.72); the 4K map tags, belt hint, craft numbers and the corner credits (v19.63 to v19.67, v19.73, v19.74) are in the change list.
now: The what is new card names the controller menus for player 2.
